title: Sales Manager – Government Business
salary: INR 10 Lakh per annum + Performance Linked Incentive
description: The Sales Manager – Government Business will own and drive revenue from government customers across central, state, and local departments. This role is hands-on and execution-heavy. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, managing the tendering process end-to-end, closing orders, and building long-term institutional relationships.
aboutRole: Drive sales of CLUIX products to central and state government departments, PSUs, and urban local bodies
Build and manage a strong pipeline of B2G opportunities
Achieve quarterly and annual revenue targets
Track relevant tenders, EoIs, RFPs, and RFQs across portals
Lead the end-to-end tendering process including documentation, coordination, and submission
Work closely with internal teams on technical and commercial compliance
Build relationships with key decision-makers, engineers, and program heads in government departments
Coordinate with implementation partners, consultants, and system integrators where required
Represent CLUIX in meetings, reviews, and government forums
Provide on-ground insights on procurement trends, budgets, and upcoming programs
Support pilot-to-scale conversions and repeat orders
skills: Strong understanding of government procurement and tender processes
Proven track record of closing government orders
Experience dealing with departments such as PHED, Jal Nigam, Municipal Corporations, State Missions, PSUs, or similar bodies is a strong advantage
Excellent communication, negotiation, and follow-up skills
eligibility: Minimum 3 years of experience in government sales or B2G product sales.
offers: Fixed Salary: INR 10 Lakh per annum
Performance Linked Incentive tied directly to closures and collections
Opportunity to grow into a senior leadership role as the government business scales
